answer: The pearl holds work receipts rather than names, so the whisper of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts, forfeited on duplicate submission, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. Reaching the comet of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys.
